Specification: This specification models a one-variable boolean state machine. The variable x is initialized to TRUE and the next-state relation flips its value on every step using boolean negation. The overall temporal specification requires the initial condition and that every step satisfies Next or is a stuttering step with respect to x; the file also defines simple state predicates about x but includes no explicit fault model, fairness, or proof obligations.
